transfer.eta.label.context: Accessible name of the ETA figure.

args.time: string: hours:minutes:seconds or minutes:seconds, e.g. 1:05:09; or ∞

transfer.eta.indeterminate.label.context: Accessible name of 'ETA ∞': downloading, but no time can be estimated.

transfer.eta.unavailable.label.context: Accessible name of the ETA dash shown when there is no reliable estimate.

extraction.failed_default.context: Reason used when an archive could not be extracted and the server gave no reason.

extraction.failed.context: Toast when a completed transfer's archive could not be extracted.

args.reason: string: the reason, from the server (may be English)

status.aria2.checking.context: Sidebar status row (Admin): checking the aria2 download engine. 'aria2' is a program name.

status.aria2.version.context: Sidebar status row: the aria2 engine answers; its version.

status.aria2.online.context: Sidebar status row: the aria2 engine answers.

status.aria2.offline.context: Sidebar status row: the aria2 engine does not answer.

status.aria2.unknown.context: Sidebar status row before its first check.

status.db.checking.context: Sidebar status row (Admin): checking the database. 'DB' = database.

status.db.sqlite.context: Sidebar status row: the database (SQLite, a product name) answers.

status.db.unknown.context: Sidebar status row before its first check.

processing.pausing.context: Pause All's label while the request runs.

processing.resuming.context: Resume All's or Resume Paused's label while the request runs.

operator_title.active.context: Browser tab title while downloads run: 'DP' (DebridPulse) then the live speed and overall progress. Keep it short.

args.speed: string: the live speed without spaces, e.g. 3.25MB/s

dashboard.kpi.exact_count.context: A Dashboard figure card's tooltip on a phone while the figure is drawn compactly (1.2K): its explanation, then the exact figure.

dashboard.kpi.paused.context: Dashboard 'Processing' card value while all processing is paused.
dashboard.kpi.paused.geometry: Dashboard figure card value: one short word.

dashboard.kpi.blocked_files.context: Line under the Dashboard 'Total Downloaded' figure: files blocked by the download safety rules.

request.failed.context: A request to the server failed and said nothing more.

quick_add.invalid_line.context: Quick Add refused one input line. Protocol names (HTTP(S), FTP, SFTP, SCP, SSH, rsync, WebDAV) and 'magnet URI' are technical names.

quick_add.empty.context: Quick Add had nothing it could submit.

quick_add.adding.context: Quick Add's Add button while it submits.

quick_add.not_submitted.context: Quick Add's links were not accepted and the server said nothing more.

quick_add.partly_failed.context: Quick Add toast: how many lines were handled and how many failed.

quick_add.link_not_added.context: Quick Add toast: the person cancelled the choice of what to download, so nothing was added.

quick_add.local_not_added.context: Quick Add toast: the person declined a transfer to a local network address.

quick_add.added_paused.context: Quick Add toast: everything was added but waits because processing is paused.

quick_add.waiting_for_resume.context: Quick Add toast: some lines wait for processing to resume ('Resume All' is the topbar button's name).

recovery.actions_applied.context: Part of the Recover All result: recovery actions taken.

recovery.transfers_imported.context: Part of the Recover All result: transfers imported from a provider.

recovery.recovering.context: Recover All's label while it runs.

recovery.finished_with_errors.context: Toast: Recover All finished but some steps failed.

recovery.complete.context: Toast: Recover All finished and did something.

args.summary: string: what it did, e.g. '2 recovery actions applied · 1 transfer imported'

recovery.nothing_found.context: Toast: Recover All found nothing to do.

theme.switch_to_dark.context: Topbar theme button in light mode (tooltip and accessible name).

theme.switch_to_light.context: Topbar theme button in dark mode (tooltip and accessible name).

speed_cap.unlimited.context: No download speed cap: the topbar cap button and the cap menu's first choice.

speed_cap.not_changed.context: Toast: the speed cap change failed for a technical reason.

args.reason: string: what failed

speed_cap.custom_invalid.context: The custom speed cap field holds no valid number.

runtime_badge.tooltip_admin.context: Tooltip of the topbar badge (Admin): active downloads out of the maximum, live speed, the speed cap.

runtime_badge.tooltip.context: Tooltip of the topbar badge for a User or ReadOnly User.

speed_cap.saved_not_applied.context: The new speed cap is saved but the running downloads did not take it.

speed_cap.not_applied.context: The new speed cap was neither saved nor applied.
